notes.title: GATETAIL 2.0 - Minor Balancing Update
notes.notes:
- Nerfed a certain boss a certain streamer may have had a certainly hard time with :)

- Various other balancing changes

notes.title: GATETAIL 2.0 - Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Reduced Inswept difficulty.

- Improved Wally.

- Added a new miniboss in Pretoria.

notes.title: GATETAIL 2.0 - Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Improved Queen Treespider bossfight.

- You can now escape the small plant thing softlock. (Sorry Lucia)

notes.title: GateTail-Windows: V:1.9 - The Preparation Update
notes.notes:
- Improved Haunted Mansion sequence
- Added some signs and tips to hopefully make things more clear
- Fixed skidding not lining up correctly after re-playing them
- Made fishing cooler
- Fixed more clipping issues arising from making traversal easier
- Some other minor bug-fixes and improvements
- Preparing for 2.0 / Brinemegeddon :)

notes.title: GateTail-Windows: V:1.885 - The Value Of Playtesting Update
notes.notes:
- More bug fixes.

- More TRUE Ending shenanigans.

- Added some stuff to Oceania's backroom.

- Fixed some more clipping issues.

- Preparing for 2.0, coming ever closer.

notes.title: GateTail-Windows: V:1.875 - The Quality Of Life Update 1.5
notes.notes:
- Changed Oceania to be easier to distinguish the floors from the walls.

- Added a small room to the back of the Aquasium.

- Fixed more clipping issues.

- The TRUE Ending bug fixes.

- More fast travel stuff.

- Slight bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: GateTail-Windows: V:1.85 - The Quality Of Life Update
notes.notes:
- Secret miniboss + ending

- Gave the player much more MAX MP during the beginning of the game

- Tweaked the difficulties' stat changes to prevent unfairness

- More moves/actions are available earlier than before

- You can now fast travel through the first area of the game

- Various other minor fixes + improvements


- Preparing for 2.0
